# LinkedIn Company Details Scraper (No Cookies)

The Apify actor [`harvestapi/linkedin-company`](https://apify.com/harvestapi/linkedin-company) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its default build **0.0.44** (module version **0.1.0**). Runs use whatever build the actor has as default when they start, so they keep working as Apify retires old builds; the input types below are refreshed weekly and can lag an actor that changed its input since.

Extract detailed information from LinkedIn Companies such as company name, address, phone numbers, website, employee count, and more. Find LinkedIn company URLs by name in Bulk. No cookies or account required.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Company $0.004, Actor Start $0.00005 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/harvestapi/linkedin-company) for current prices.

  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/harvestapi-linkedin-company@0.1.0#sha256-…

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs: {}
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `companies` | array |  |  | Company LinkedIn URLs — List of LinkedIn company URLs |
| `searches` | array |  |  | Company names (to search) — List of company names to search on LinkedIn |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
